failed_hard_gates.evidence: The supporting-foot band is traceable beneath the raised arch, but the lifted-foot band is visible mainly along the lateral instep and its under-arch crossing is not unambiguous in native pixels.
Both feet show blue bands, yet only the supporting foot clearly proves the complete hem-to-underfoot loop; the lifted side does not provide equally complete matching construction.
